causalModel.founding: Built as a fixture: ten kit pieces, each on ground under 2 deg, to prove the settlement runtime.
causalModel.occupantsMotive: None: the yard has no occupants and no lore.
causalModel.pressures: None: the yard is never published to the shipped build.
causalModel.siteAdvantages: Empty measured ground at mean slope 4.08 deg with recorded water 60.6 m east for the berth.
causalModel.wouldChangeIf: A kit piece under test changes, or the runtime contract moves.
